# Embedded emissions cannot be calculated

The ruleset requires three inputs. One is missing:

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code in the table | "a steel product" (no CN code) | ❌ Missing |
| (b) Country of production | China | ✅ Listed |
| (c) Quantity (tonnes) | 500 t | ✅ Provided |

**Why this matters:** The SEE depends on both the CN code and the country. The table has several China entries for iron and steel goods, with SEEs from 1.66 to 3.314 tCO2e/t. "Steel product" could match more than one code, so I can't pick one. The ruleset says not to estimate when an input is missing.

## What's needed
Please give the **CN code** of the good. If it's one of the codes below, the result for 500 t made in China would be:

| CN code | Good | China SEE (tCO2e/t) | Result if this code applies (tCO2e) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, iron/non-alloy steel | 1.74 | 870.00 |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products, iron/non-alloy steel | 3.314 | 1,657.00 |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods with indentations (rebar) | 3.169 | 1,584.50 |

*(7201, pig iron and spiegeleisen, is listed at 1.66 tCO2e/t but is not usually called a steel product.)*

These figures depend on the CN code. They are not a determination. If the good's CN code isn't in the table, embedded emissions can't be calculated under this ruleset.
